title: Lux East Nash Retreat/11 Beds
description:
Experience the vibrant charm of East Nashville from the comfort of this spacious, modern retreat. Boasting 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, and 11 beds, our luxurious home is perfect for family gatherings, group getaways, or special celebrations. Enjoy breathtaking skyline views from multiple vantage points, offering a picture-perfect backdrop for your stay!

The space
Location, Location, Location!

Nestled in the heart of East Nashville, you’ll find yourself within minutes of:

• Downtown Nashville (just a short drive or rideshare away)

• Trendy restaurants, coffee shops, and boutiques

• Popular music venues and vibrant nightlife

• Local markets and unique art galleries

The Space

• Room for Everyone: With 11 comfortable beds, this home accommodates large groups with ease.

Bedroom 1) 2 Queen

Bedroom 2) 1 Queen 2 twin

Bedroom 3) 1 Queen, 2 twin

Bedroom 4) 1 Queen, 3 twin

• Modern Comfort: Thoughtfully designed with sleek décor, high-end finishes, and plenty of natural light.

• Fully Equipped Kitchen: Cook like a pro with premium appliances and ample space for dining.

• Entertainment Hub: Spacious living area with a large Smart TV, perfect for movie nights.

• Rooftop Patio: Sip on cocktails while enjoying stunning views of the Nashville skyline.

• Private Bathrooms: Each bedroom has convenient access to a stylish bathroom.

Why You’ll Love It Here

• Luxurious and spacious for large groups

• Unbeatable skyline views

• Close to everything Nashville has to offer

• Perfect for both relaxation and celebration

Book your stay today and experience the best of Music City from this stunning East Nashville retreat. We can’t wait to host you!

 In order to receive promotional discount, it must be requested at the time of booking.

Guest access
You’ll have the entire home to yourself, including free parking and keyless entry for convenience.

Other things to note
Close to EVERYTHING!!
